basis: US Gulf Coast, 2024 USD; the agent must cite these and may not set prices

natural_gas.source: PetroLogistics Catofin plant gas cost 2.60 USD/MMBtu (SEC 424B4, 2012); Henry Hub 2024 average 2.19 USD/MMBtu (EIA)
natural_gas.note: high end covers European hub prices

electricity.source: industrial power assumption used across the NCE chains; EIA 2024 US industrial average about 80 USD/MWh

hydrogen.source: Becker, Penev & Braun, J. Energy Resour. Technol. 2019 anchor 3 USD/kg; grey about 2, electrolytic 5-7 (DOE Pathways to Commercial Liftoff: Clean Hydrogen, 2024)

carbon_dioxide.source: 104 USD/t CO2 captured, Enterprise Products EPA GHG permit application 2012, rounded

propane.source: EIA Mont Belvieu propane spot 2024, 0.778 USD/gal at 4.2 lb/gal

ammonia.source: Tampa CFR ammonia, March 2024 contract settlement (trade press summary)

ethanol.source: Haro et al. 2013, Table 9 (Brazilian hydrated ethanol)

catalyst_support_and_manufacturing.source: NCE chain assumption for support plus manufacturing per kg of finished catalyst, excluding active metals
